Retrieval limits of the register endpoints

Source: R/tidybrreg-package.R
tidybrreg_endpoints.Rd

One row per endpoint reachable through the fifteen exports, with the pagination model, the retrieval window, and how the package behaves at the boundary. The evidence column separates what BRREG documents (https://data.brreg.no/enhetsregisteret/api/dokumentasjon/) from what has been observed against the live service; limits observed for one route are never assumed for another. Boundary probes for the search routes run in the scheduled live test workflow (tests/testthat/test-liveapi-audit.R).

Rate limiting

BRREG publishes no rate limit or rate-limit headers; the package throttles itself to 5 requests per second per host and retries 429, 503, 500, 502 and 504 up to three times, as well as connection failures and the register's rate limit when it arrives as HTTP 200 with the text Too many requests (then a tidybrreg_error_rate_limited). The Regnskapsregisteret 500 for an unsupported accounting plan is final. Request timeouts are httr2's defaults.
